datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Somalia in 2015. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases mapped to geographic units, with multiple scenarios documented for January, April, July, and October 2015.
